question: What are the fees of the fund?
answer:
The fee structure is as follows:
• Exit Load: 1% for partial or full exits within 12 months of investment
• Management Fee: 1% per annum, charged monthly on daily average AUM
• Performance Fee: 15% over a 7% hurdle rate, subject to a high-water mark
• Operating Fee: On actuals, capped at 0.5% per annum on AUM
